1.consolidated_definition: Hierba rugosa de hasta 70 cm de altura, con ramas estriadas y aladas, hojas alternas aovadas y a veces lanceoladas y flor solitaria de color amarillo anaranjado con largo pedúnculo. Asteraceae Verbesina alata.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Rough-leaved herb of up to 70 cm in height, with striated and winged branches, alternate ovate to lanceolate leaves, and solitary yellow-orange flower with a long peduncle. Asteraceae Verbesina alata.
